returned.text: {"question_target":"T05","reply":"A simple place to start is this: Medicare is federal health insurance, and there are two main ways to get it. One is Original Medicare, which is Part A and Part B through the federal program. The other is Medicare Advantage, where a private plan provides Parts A and B. With Original Medicare, drug coverage is separate and Medigap may help with your share of costs. With Medicare Advantage, most plans include drug coverage. The Part B premium still applies either way.
